blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Talking about how you feel is a work skill too. It is not drama. It is honesty.

A short sentence helps the team a lot. You can say "I feel tired but ready." Now the team knows how your day is going. They can help you or wait a moment.

Today we use "I feel" and an adjective. For example: happy, tired, busy, ready, calm. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: According to the text, talking about your feelings at work is…
items.why: "Talking about how you feel is a work skill too."

items.q: What does a short sentence like "I feel tired but ready" do?
items.why: "A short sentence helps the team a lot."

items.q: Which words does the text use as examples?
items.why: "For example: happy, tired, busy, ready, calm."

items.q: The text says "It is not drama. It is honesty." This suggests that the author…
options: thinks sharing feelings is calm and honest
thinks people cry too much at work
wants people to hide their feelings
items.why: Inferência: para o autor, dizer como você se sente é honestidade simples, não exagero.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which sentence?
options: A short honest sentence can help the team.
You should never tell the team how you feel.
Feelings can be a work skill.
"I feel ready" gives the team good news.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende falar como você se sente; esconder isso é o contrário da ideia.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando sobre o seu dia no trabalho. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi team. Good morning. It is Monday here at Czarnikow. Before we start, let me tell you how I feel today. It is a simple thing, but it helps.

I feel happy. It is a good day, the sun is out, and the coffee is nice. But I am also busy. I have three emails and one short report to finish before lunch. So I feel a little tired too. That is okay. I have time.

Right now, I feel calm. The plan is clear, and I know my tasks for the day. At ten o'clock we have a short meeting about the new client. I feel ready for it. I have my notes here on the desk.

And how do you feel today? Please tell me. You can say "I feel fine" or "I feel busy" or "I feel ready." A short sentence is enough. When I know how you feel, I can help you or give you more time. We are a team.

Okay. Let's start the day. Take your time, and ask me if you need help. I feel good about our work. Thank you, everyone.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Sophie feel at the start?
items.why: "I feel happy. It is a good day."

items.q: Why is Sophie also a little tired?
options: She is busy with emails and a report
items.why: "I am also busy. I have three emails and one report… So I feel a little tired too."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the ten o'clock meeting?
items.why: "At ten o'clock we have a short meeting. I feel ready for it."

items.q: Why does Sophie ask the team how they feel?
options: So she can help them or give them more time
items.why: Inferência: "When I know how you feel, I can help you or give you more time."

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela fala devagar, agradece e oferece ajuda — um tom calmo e gentil.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I feel happy today because the project is going well." Happy means…
items.why: Happy = feliz.

items.q: "After the long call, she feels tired." Tired means…
items.why: Tired = cansado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have many emails this morning, so I am very ___."
items.why: Busy = ocupado. Muitos e-mails deixam você ocupado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have my notes, so I feel ___ for the meeting."
items.why: Ready = pronto. Com as notas em mãos, você está pronto.

items.q: "The plan is clear and I feel calm." Calm means…
items.why: Calm = calmo, tranquilo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia do trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: A colleague asks how you are and you say: "I'm fine, thanks." This means you are…
items.why: "I'm fine, thanks" = estou bem, obrigado(a). Uma resposta simples e positiva.

items.q: Before a hard task, a friend says: "Take your time." This means…
options: do it slowly, do not rush
items.why: "Take your time" = vá com calma, não tenha pressa.

items.q: The team is ready and Sophie says: "Let's start." This means…
items.why: "Let's start" = vamos começar.

items.q: Sophie says: "I feel good about our work." This means she…
options: is happy and positive about it
items.why: "Feel good about" = sentir-se bem/positivo em relação a algo.

items.q: A colleague looks tired, so you say: "Are you okay?" You are…
items.why: "Are you okay?" = você está bem? Uma pergunta simples e gentil sobre como a pessoa se sente.
